name: Yigit Aku Malzemeleri Nakliyat Turizm Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Yigit Aku Malzemeleri Nakliyat Turizm Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. specializes in the production and distribution of a wide array of batteries. Their product line includes starter batteries designed for various uses, such as automobiles, EFB and AGM start-stop systems, taxis, agricultural machinery, marine applications, heavy-duty vehicles, and the defense industry. Beyond these, the company also offers industrial batteries, comprising AGM, motive power, gel, FFP, front terminal, motorcycle, traction, and both OPZS and OPZV stationary types, in addition to lithium battery solutions. These diverse products are sold under several proprietary brand names, including Platin, Helden Akü, Tunç Akü, Turkuaz Akü, Macpower, Gentry, Vesline, Distalong, Fierte, Probat, and Yigit Akü. Established in 1976, Yigit Aku Malzemeleri A.S. operates from its base in Ankara, Turkey.
